External native call folding libogg's ogg_sync_buffer(oy, size) + memcpy + ogg_sync_wrote(oy, bytes) into a single JNI call; appends `length` bytes from `data` into the sync layer's demux buffer. External native call matching libogg ogg_sync_pageout(oy, og); extracts the next complete page from the sync buffer into `page`. Returns >0 on success, 0 if more data is needed, <0 if a sync gap was skipped. Confirmed call site OggMediaStream.kt: `while (anOggSyncState987.pageOut(anOggPage981) <= 0) { ... write more data ... }`.

Private external native call matching libogg ogg_sync_pageseek(oy, og); used internally to resync to the next page boundary after corrupt/incomplete data, returning bytes skipped (negative) or bytes verified (positive/zero). No call sites found in the Kotlin sources - unused/dead here.

Companion-object protected external native constructor, called unqualified from the instance init block (`init(); check(!this.b())`) to allocate the native ogg_sync_state peer; maps to libogg ogg_sync_init(oy). Renamed to avoid confusion with Kotlin's init{} block keyword, matching the initInfo/initBlock/initStream pattern used across sibling jagtheora classes. Note: unlike VorbisInfo/TheoraInfo, this class's companion has no static init{} block of its own - init() is invoked directly from the outer class's instance init block.
